title: B8.4 author's expected outcome for one submission (PROVISIONAL)
description: What the author designed each rubric criterion to show: the intended machine-check results and a qualitative judgement with the reasoning. It is NOT a reference grade and carries no scores; reference grades come only from a mentor (PRD B8) and live in reference-grades/.

criterion.description: Exactly the Criterion cell of the marking table.

checks.description: One entry per check in the marking table's Check cell, in order; empty when the cell is '—'.

expected.description: pass, fail and error as in design §5.2; undetermined when the result cannot be predicted yet (command:<name> has no check config, design Q33).

judgement.description: The author's intended reading of 'Full marks when'. Not a score.
